events.description: Multiple players from opposing teams engage in a physical altercation near the boards, with shoving, grabbing, and at least one player being restrained by officials or teammates.

The initial fight escalates into a large-scale on-ice brawl involving numerous players from both teams; sticks are raised, players converge in a chaotic cluster, and multiple simultaneous physical confrontations occur across the group.

Multiple individuals in high-visibility yellow vests (some with numbers like '29' and '17') are engaged in sustained physical combat with others near a barrier/railing; actions include grappling, pushing, striking, and one person being lifted or thrown over the railing (e.g., f0, f3, f6, f14, f15). The interaction is mutual and dynamic across the sequence.

A large group of people, including multiple uniformed personnel in yellow vests, are involved in chaotic, collective violent unrest around a barrier; objects appear to be thrown or used as weapons, and the scene shows widespread disorder beyond isolated fighting (e.g., f10–f13 show scattered debris and multiple simultaneous clashes).

A chaotic crowd scene with multiple individuals in high-visibility vests (likely security or emergency personnel) engaged in intense physical struggle against a dense crowd behind a barrier; objects are being thrown, people are climbing or being pushed over the barrier, and there is sustained violent group interaction consistent with a riot.

Close-up interactions among individuals in high-visibility vests show mutual grappling, punching, and shoving—e.g., frame f5 shows two vests locked in close combat; frames f6–f8 show repeated striking and clinching motions—indicating mutual physical combat rather than one-sided aggression.

In later frames, individuals appear subdued or pinned on the ground while others in vests apply force (e.g., pressing down, holding limbs), suggesting attacks on helpless victims; frame f12–f15 show at least one person lying prone while others stand over them with raised arms or hands on body, consistent with abuse.

Multiple individuals in high-visibility yellow vests (likely security or emergency personnel) are engaged in intense physical combat with others near a barrier; visible grappling, pushing, and striking actions occur across the sequence.

A chaotic group confrontation involving multiple participants in yellow vests and civilians, with crowd surging, barriers being overwhelmed, and coordinated aggressive behavior indicating collective violent unrest.

Multiple individuals in yellow-and-black uniforms (likely security or emergency personnel) are engaged in physical struggle with several other individuals in the stands; visible grappling, pushing, and attempts to restrain or subdue others across the sequence.

Escalating collective unrest in the spectator area: multiple people standing, moving aggressively, and engaging in group confrontations alongside the security personnel; chaotic motion and clustering suggest violent group clashes beyond isolated fighting.

Multiple individuals in the stands appear engaged in mutual physical combat, with visible grappling and pushing; players on the ice (e.g., #25, #16) are observing or reacting to the disturbance above.

The disturbance escalates into a broader chaotic crowd event in the stands, with multiple people moving violently and densely packed; players line up along the boards watching, suggesting a large-scale disruption beyond isolated fighting.
A renewed burst of physical confrontation occurs in the stands, visible as blurred motion and close contact among spectators; players remain lined up, indicating ongoing disruption.
